sources.title: 荒川の概要
sources.publisher: 国土交通省 関東地方整備局 荒川下流河川事務所
supports: the lower 22 kilometres are an artificial floodway
the 1910 flood triggered the improvement plan
water first passed through the floodway in 1924

sources.title: 2. 荒川放水路の開削
sources.publisher: 国土交通省 関東地方整備局 荒川下流河川事務所
supports: about 1300 households moved for the project
the 1924 Iwabuchi gate completion connected the route
the full project was completed in 1930
a 2.83 metre level difference between the floodway and Sumida River was observed during the 1925 flood

sources.title: 荒川放水路通水100周年
sources.publisher: 国土交通省 関東地方整備局
supports: the historical design divided 3340 cubic metres per second toward the floodway and 830 cubic metres per second toward the Sumida River
ground subsidence and zero-metre districts remain important present-day risk context

sources.title: 日本の川 関東 荒川 荒川の主な災害
sources.publisher: 国土交通省 水管理・国土保全局
supports: the 1910 flood record lists 324 dead or missing and 84538 inundated houses

claims_policy: Historical values are stated as reported by the listed public-agency sources. The episode explains a civil-engineering mechanism and does not claim that a floodway removes all flood risk.
